title: CtlFleetResponse
description: The dashboard's one poll (`GET /v1/fleet`, every 15 s): host facts plus one summary row per registry tenant. This is the VIEWER-safe shape by construction — every field is the summary set, so viewers and operators receive the same body. Nothing here is a path to a secret file, a key value, or a fingerprint; a conformance test walks the whole tree and refuses any field name matching `(?i)(api_key|password|secret|token|dsn)`.

tenants.description: In `display_order`, then any tenant not listed there, by name.

disk_free_bytes.description: Free bytes on the filesystem holding `rag_root` (`vg1-rag`).

linger.description: `/var/lib/systemd/linger/svcbvbrc` exists — the user manager survives logout and starts at boot.

ctl_unit_active.description: `ragstack-ctl.service` is `active` in the svcbvbrc user manager (false when the daemon was started by hand).

sudoers_group.description: Members of the group ADR-0007 lists as fleet admins (`seed-admins-svcbvbrc`). Usernames, not secrets.

UnitState.description: systemd `ActiveState` for a `systemd`-supervised tenant; for a `manual` one, `active` when the pidfile's process is alive with the expected cwd/cmdline, `inactive` otherwise, `n/a` when the tenant has no such service.

stores_mode.description: `dedicated`: both qdrant and elasticsearch are `exclusive`. `shared`: both on the shared stores. `mixed`: one of each (lucid-next). `unknown`: ownership not yet confirmed.

health.description: `api`: `GET /health` on the tenant API. `qdrant`/`es`: the store probe (`/collections`, `_cluster/health`) — `n/a` for a shared store the ctl only observes. `deep`: the tenant's `/v1/health/deep`, `unknown` when the probe is disabled or the API is down.

disk_bytes.description: `du` of `data_dir`, cached (at most once per 5 min).
